exposure: Maternal glycemic status (Gestational Glucose Intolerance - 0 abnormal values)
Maternal glycemic status (Gestational Glucose Intolerance - 1 abnormal value)
outcome: Neonatal hypoglycemia (blood glucose <45 mg/dL or ICD-9/10 diagnosis)
cohort: The study participants were 8,262 mother-infant dyads who delivered at two hospitals between 2014 and 2023.
finding: Gestational glucose intolerance (GGI) and gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) are associated with an increased risk of neonatal hypoglycemia, with higher odds observed as maternal glycemic status progresses from GGI-0 to GGI-1 to GDM.
